topic: How to Evaluate a Small Industrial or Flex Property
caption:
Lesson 43: Evaluate a small industrial or flex property with a practical, repeatable checklist tailored for Chester and Montgomery counties. Focus first on site access, loading configuration, clear heights, utilities and power capacity, and zoning or permit requirements. Evaluate structural and roof condition, HVAC and electrical systems, and how the building fits tenant operational needs. Account for typical operating costs—taxes, insurance, utilities, maintenance, and common area upkeep—while recognizing this checklist does not replace financing analysis, tenant build-out negotiations, market rent studies, or environmental assessments. Use the local example to guide on-site inspections, lease negotiations, and capital planning. For a downloadable checklist, local guidance, and one-on-one coaching, visit dmsellscre.com/investors to get started.
